name: learner_task
description: Private daily French practice tasks, status, and stored content for one Parle learner

user_id.description: Buildy account id of the owning learner

task_key.description: Stable week-plan-scoped task key for safe repeat visits

date_local.description: Learner-local date as YYYY-MM-DD, empty when a tutor suggestion has no matching day

scheduled_at_utc.description: UTC ISO timestamp anchored to the learner-local calendar date

skill.description: Primary skill, empty for a multi-skill check-in or tutor suggestion

minutes.description: Task duration chosen by the deterministic engine

reason.description: Deterministic reason for including the task

reason_skill.description: Skill named in the task reason, empty when not applicable

status.description: Daily task state; tutor suggestions are never booked

rollover_count.description: Number of times this task has rolled to a later day

optional.description: True for a tutor lesson suggestion that is not part of committed daily minutes

tutor_window.description: Learner-selected tutor time window for a Suggested lesson

original_date_local.description: First learner-local date assigned to this task

content_json.description: AI-generated practice content or approved question-bank fallback

content_source.description: Origin of the stored task content

source_ref.description: Approved bank record reference, empty when AI generated

completed_at_utc.description: UTC timestamp when the learner marked a task done
